    - heading "Understand Fixed Angle" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A fixed angle construction keeps a chosen angle measure constant while points move. In Fixed Angle, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Fixed angle: measure(angle ABC)=constant. You can learn Fixed Angle by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Choose a vertex and starting ray. Set the angle measure. Construct the second ray at that fixed turn. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
